description: ### Cedar Rapids, Iowa – On primary election night, Iowans from different backgrounds and walks of life took the stage to share why they support Ashley Hinson for U.S. Senate. A retired law enforcement leader and lifelong Democrat, a veteran who experienced Ashley’s constituent services firsthand, and a working father all highlighted Ashley’s record of putting results ahead of politics and fighting for Iowa families. Retired Chief Deputy Doug Riniker“Ashley’s actions, character, integrity and experience is everything I look for in a public servant.”Watch his full speech here. “…To be honest, I never imagined I’d be standing at a Republican election night event speaking in support of Ashley. But doing what’s right matters far more than any political affiliation. “[Ashley] has never let political labels get in the way of getting the job done. Ashley’s always known that I’m a Democrat…yet time and again, she reached out for my perspective on law enforcement issues…Real conversations always provide greater solutions. Ashley’s approach to problem solving speaks volumes to her character and leadership style. “For those of us that have worked in the law enforcement profession, trust is not easily given, it has to be earned…Ashley has earned my trust.” Working Father Landis […]
